title: Stop interrupts whatever the shared engine is running, even another instance's job
description: Every app instance attaches to the one ComfyUI on port 48188 (routes/comfy.js MPI-484). An interrupt with no prompt_id kills whatever is executing, whoever queued it. Both commandExecutor.js interrupt sites: ~1336 (pre-register) and ~1396 (frozen-engine interrupt). Research: does our pinned ComfyUI accept a prompt_id on its interrupt route (newer ComfyUI does)? If yes, send it; if not, delete our queued prompt instead of interrupting when ours is not the one running. Live 2026-09-25: an isolated instance's cancels interrupted Fabio's H3 renders 047e722a (13:58:32Z) and fec48cbb (14:03:23Z); the engine history shows execution_interrupted 1 s after each. WARNING for tests: an app:isolated instance shares Fabio's engine - check its queue is empty first. Reported by peer 'Agent integration plan 2' (MPI-593).
